The '''personal translator''' was a small portable [[Electronic translator/Legends|electronic translator]] device used for communication. It could be worn around the neck or carried in a pocket. It could translate verbal commands in the owner's language and up to three other spoken languages. It had no sensors so it was only good for audio conversations.

[[Personal Universal Translator]] was one of the known models.
